proof_review.derivation: With T the folded grid, B_i,d the exact strict bad-time set and U=T minus already assigned bad sets, each completion covers at most sum_i max_d |U intersect B_i,d| of U. If |U| strictly exceeds that sum, every completion leaves some uncovered time, hence has a grid witness. The witness may depend on the completion. Equality never suffices.
proof_review.quantifier_counterexample: Actual tight-terminal-0 first-five digits [4,2,6,0,1], j=2: all fixed coordinates good and some good digit exists for every remaining coordinate, but the archived completion has coordinate6 bad and has no grid witness at any j. Intersection of per-axis unions of good choices is only existential-completion evidence and cannot close a full branch.
proof_review.resource_review: Initial Core consumer rebuilt every prefix at each leaf and could exceed20M verification work even for a20M-bounded producer. Reported to Contractor/Core with recommendation to propagate independently derived U only along verified child edges, retaining exact bounds and fixed limits. Contractor approved and Core Builder implemented this induction-equivalent optimization; no Core edits by this Builder. The fresh eight-domain diagnostic below uses the repaired Core and final Python source pin. Final default-cap report verification is Contractor-owned.
